SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 哎，这地上的垃圾是怎么回事
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 唉，這地上的垃圾是怎麼回事
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اوه، این سطل زباله چه خبره.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Should I… clean it up first?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 片付けてから行ったほうがいいか？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Harusnya… aku beresin dulu nggak, ya?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Será que eu devia juntar antes de continuar?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ah, what do I do — I don’t have time…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 但...時間不夠了...怎麼辦啊
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: でも時間が…どうしよう…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aduh, gimana dong — waktuku nggak cukup…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah, o que eu faço? Não tenho tempo…
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آه، چه کار کنم - وقت ندارم…
